meta.title: Model Price
meta.description: Per-model API prices in USD or CNY, wallet balance and live session spend under the composer.

strings.resetConfirm: Reset the all-time total? Session history is kept.
strings.settingsIntro: Prices per million tokens. An empty cache-hit price is charged at the input price; an empty Off-Peak column uses the Peak price. Prices are applied retroactively to the whole session history.
strings.peakExplainer: Peak hours are 01:00–04:00 and 06:00–10:00 UTC, Monday to Friday, excluding holidays. All other hours — nights, weekends and holidays — are Off-Peak at half the Peak price. The preset list follows DeepSeek's Chinese public holidays; replace it if your provider bills another country's holidays.
strings.offWindowHint: DeepSeek default 16:30–00:30 UTC. Only a badge and a price selector use it.
strings.hideWalletHint: The eye toggle on the composer line persists this.
strings.hideLineHint: Removes the line from every session; settings stay available.
strings.budgetHint: Used only when the account balance is unavailable.
strings.noModels: No models yet. Add one below or wait for the first request.
strings.checkUpdatesHint: Automatic check: one request to GitHub every 6 hours. The button checks manually at any time.
strings.showBestTimeLabel: Show the best time in the popover
strings.showBestTimeHint: Displays the cheap window and a countdown to it.
strings.loadModelsHint: The list mirrors Settings → Models; models not configured there are removed.
strings.discountsHint: The shared Peak schedule applies to every model without its own schedule; a model can override it in its card under Models.
strings.modelScheduleLabel: Own Peak schedule for this model
strings.modelScheduleHint: These windows, days and holidays apply to this model only.
strings.peakWindowsHint: Comma-separated ranges, for example 01:00-04:00, 06:00-10:00. Everything outside them is Off-Peak.
strings.holidaysHint: YYYY-MM-DD, comma-separated. These dates are fully Off-Peak for this schedule.
strings.sourceUrlHint: Link to the page the prices were taken from (http/https).
strings.billingFromHint: Successful calls before this instant are free. DeepSeek: 2026-10-31 16:00 UTC.
